title: When can two searches stop?
hook: Make a prediction. Inspect the steps. Test a second input.

knows: Compare numbers; read a short array, string, tree or graph as drawn.
doesNotKnow: Stop bidirectional shortest-path search only when frontier lower bounds cannot beat the best meeting route.

misconception: The first touched vertex between weighted searches always proves the shortest route.
objective: Stop bidirectional shortest-path search only when frontier lower bounds cannot beat the best meeting route.
